'''Aliquis's brother''' (Japanese: '''アリキスの兄''' ''Aliquis's brother'') is a minor character in ''[[Pokémon: Paldean Winds]]''. He is [[Aliquis]]' brother.

He attended [[Blueberry Academy]] and appeared in ''[[PPW02|Breathe In]]'', where he talked to his brother via [[Rotom Phone]], suggesting him not to use his {{TP|Aliquis|Meowscarada}} again in his next {{pkmn|battle}} against [[Nemona]].
